showcase_toolchain.golden_command:
DIALECTS_ROOT=$(pwd)
GOLDEN_WORKDIR=${GOLDEN_WORKDIR:?}
export ROOTFORM_HOME=$GOLDEN_WORKDIR/home
mkdir -p $GOLDEN_WORKDIR/vendor-$(date +%s); V=$(ls -d $GOLDEN_WORKDIR/vendor-* | tail -1)
for d in $(python3 -c "import json;print(' '.join(x['name'] for x in json.load(open('$DIALECTS_ROOT/dialects.json'))['dialects']))"); do cp -R $DIALECTS_ROOT/$d $V/$d; done
mkdir -p $GOLDEN_WORKDIR/fx/<name>/.rootform && cp $DIALECTS_ROOT/fixtures/slice/<name>/*.tf $GOLDEN_WORKDIR/fx/<name>/ && cp -R $V $GOLDEN_WORKDIR/fx/<name>/.rootform/dialects
cd $GOLDEN_WORKDIR && { $ROOTFORM_BIN build fx/<name> --offline --no-input; printf '\n'; } > $DIALECTS_ROOT/fixtures/slice/<name>/architecture.golden
showcase_toolchain.golden_generator: Regenerated goldens record generator.version 0.1.1; rootform test accepts that candidate version while dialect versions remain 0.1.0.

showcase_negative_assertions: AKS literal and unknown workspace IDs produce no observed-by relation
Service Bus literal and unknown namespace/topic IDs produce no ownership or subscribes-to fact
Event Grid literal and unknown handler IDs produce no delivers-to relation
Web workload literal and unknown references produce no ownership, network, runtime, or observed-by fact
Container Apps literal and unknown references produce no ownership, network, runtime, or observed-by fact
Compute literal and unknown resource-group names produce no ownership context
VNet peering literal and unknown references produce no network context
NAT association unknown references produce no contribution

limitations: One representative direct identity per family; family internals remain covered by matrix and compiler tests.
Producer, consumer, backend, secret-use, peering, VPN, and ExpressRoute relations remain absent because provider references alone do not prove those architecture facts.
Only exact literal ARM type and API-version values match; generic body evidence emits no facts.
Unapproved generic AzAPI overlap and patch resources never duplicate the typed AzureRM owner.
AzAPI body and literal parent resource ID remain outside Architecture IR and HTML.
